metadata.title: Cybersecurity Control Catalog - Cryptography, Encryption and Key Management

props.name: keywords
props.value: IM8, GovTech, Singapore, cybersecurity, Cryptography, Encryption and Key Management

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Insecure cryptographic key establishment can lead to weak or broken encryption.

links.text: Cryptography, Encryption and Key Management Control Catalog

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Use industry-standard cryptographic key establishment schemes and key derivation methods.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Refer to SP 800-56A, SP 800-56B, and SP 800-56C for updated industry-standard cryptographic key establishment schemes and key derivation methods. Cloud services such as AWS Key Management Service and Azure Key Vault can be used for generating and managing cryptographic keys.

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Failing to rotate cryptographic keys increases the risk of broken encryption.

links.text: Cryptography, Encryption and Key Management Control Catalog

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Rotate cryptographic keys every {{ insert: param, ck-2_prm_1 }} days.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Cloud services such as AWS Key Management Service and Azure Key Vault enable automatic rotation of cryptographic keys.

guidelines.prose: The time period in days of cryptographic key rotation frequency.

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Inadequate key management increase the risk of unauthorised access, data breaches, and compromised cryptographic operations due to poorly managed or safeguarded cryptographic keys.

links.text: Cryptography, Encryption and Key Management Control Catalog

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement cryptographic key management processes to ensure cryptographic keys are well-managed and safeguarded throughout their lifecycle.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Follow key management practices such as those described in NIST SP 800-57 or ISO/IEC 27017 to cover aspects including generation, registration, storage, distribution, installation, use, rotation, backup, recovery, revocation, suspension, and destruction of keys.

props.name: risk-statement
props.value: Inadequate key storage and access controls can lead to unauthorised key access and potential data breaches.

links.text: Cryptography, Encryption and Key Management Control Catalog

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Securely store cryptographic keys and implement strict access controls based on the principle of least privilege.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Use cloud services such as AWS Key Management Service and Azure Key Vault to securely store cryptographic keys with access controls.
